outcome: Differences in gut microbiota between neonates with and without NAS
Relationship between gut microbiota and NAS symptom expression and severity
Changes in gut microbiota diversity during NAS treatment
finding: Neonates with NAS had different gut microbiota compared to those without NAS, and specific bacteria were associated with increased NAS symptom severity.
mod_finding: This study found that differences in gut microbiota between infants with and without NAS may be due to differences in birth mode and type of feeding.
